input.function: FabricDownloader.firstStableVersion (and the equivalent inline loader-entry scan)

raw_response.note: synthetic -- a dev-build-only loader response shape, not present in the real corpus recording, which only ever showed a version with a stable build available

expected.reason: no entry has loader.stable == true, so the `?? loaderList[0]` fallback (ServerJarProviders.swift:438) wins -- the FIRST entry in response order, not the highest build number

notes: The fallback half of the same "first stable, else first" rule exercised by fabric-loader-and-installer-first-stable-selection. Genuinely reachable in production: a freshly cut Minecraft version can have only unstable dev-build Fabric loaders published before a stable one lands. Both the inline loader-entry scan (`downloadLatest`/`downloadVersion`) and the standalone `firstStableVersion(from:what:)` helper (used for the installer list, and for the game-version resolution in `downloadLatest`) share this exact `first { stable } ?? list[0]` shape.
